ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through Amazon Web Services (AWS) Marketplace, giving organizations a simpler way to bring ChatGPT to their teams.

Customers can use their existing AWS purchasing and billing relationship and apply eligible spend toward AWS commitments, with the same capabilities and access to new features at the same time as buying directly from OpenAI.

Learn more:
 https://lnkd.in/g9Es3F9g
